description:
Use this when the user names an Indian company, NSE symbol, BSE code or ISIN and you need to identify the listed security before calling another tool. Not for US or other non-Indian stocks.

Returns matching securities with ISIN, NSE symbol, BSE code, name, sector and industry. It accepts part of a name, a former name, and everyday names such as SBI or L&T; `resolved_via` says when a match came from a former or everyday name. When nothing matches, the nearest names come back as suggestions with `reason_code: "typo_suggestion"`: confirm one with the user before using it. `limit` is 10 by default and at most 50, and a broad name can have more matches than are returned. Pass a returned NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code as `query` to any per-company tool.

query.description: Company name or part of it, or an NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code.
query.title: Query

name: search_stocks
